identity_notes: Commit IDs identify immutable source trees; standalone SHA-256/length pairs identify the exact inspected bytes. Report target commits do not make external reports tracked source.
Absolute paths, branch names, working-tree state and observed_at_utc are local observation-time metadata, not immutable authority.
The authorization/session log can receive later coordinator updates; its hash records the observed version only. The preserved snapshot remains identified separately by its archive binding.
New independent oracle outputs postdate archival scope. Their exact hashes and ARTIFACT-HASHES.json are checked, but no archive coverage is invented.
This manifest and the three new documents exclude self/circular hashes; the final source-manifest hash and documentation commit belong to the external handoff.
Operational database/log/credential contents are never embedded here. Inventory metadata points to the controlled local archive.
preservation_limits: APFS copy-on-write copies and restore on the same disk, not off-device backup.
Update-capable historical transcript has only an observed-byte snapshot; no future append coverage.
34 inventoried common Git databases plus a 35th unborn tooling database, not 35 committed product repositories.
Scoped restore integrity does not authenticate historical runs, certify environment portability or prove runtime conformance.
